ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in lobe centers versus 30% low-intensity black pixels on margins and median.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs occupy the medial-to-distal regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black bands define the trailing edge and outer margins. A vertical black column extends through the longitudinal axis at the median notch, with dense speckling/mottling at the contrast interfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serration along the posterior boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 3 to 15 pixels, with more pronounced jagged peaks on the distal thirds.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on the distal margins, terminating at sharply upturned, irregular tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, high-relief pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Small discrete circular dark spots (~4-10 pixels) distributed within the white central fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of 4-5 parallel low-intensity vertical linear marks (rake marks) on the lower ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization causing significant three-dimensional textural deformation on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'brush-stroke' vertical black pigmentation patterns extending from the peduncle into the white field of the central fluke area.
